name: Russia expands egg exports to tackle oversupply crisis
snippet:
26 Sept 2025 — In a strategic move to address a growing oversupply crisis, Russia has significantly ramped up its egg exports in 2025 .
To mitigate the crisis, Russia has targeted key export markets. Kazakhstan, Mongolia, and the United Arab Emirates have emerged as primary destinations, accounting for 43%, 28%, and 21% of exports respectively.

name: Russia expands egg exports in a bid to mitigate oversupply
snippet: Russia exports eggs primarily to Kazakhstan, Mongolia and the UAE . During the first 8 months of 2025, Russia exported 12500 tonnes of eggs.
